margin: built the thing that will hold it
items.body: Spent an hour building a site designed to be nothing like Instagram, and the first draft was Instagram. The grammar of the feed is so ambient now that you reproduce it by accident, in the exact act of trying to escape it.
items.note: Rounded corners. That was the whole tell. Rounded corners and reverse-chronological order.

items.body: Every group chat has one person quietly keeping it alive, and it is never the person who talks most.
A napkin diagram I no longer understand. Appears to be either a business model or a seating chart.
Nobody has ever described their own taste accurately. You can only be caught having it.
